connector.name: Quriov
connector.registryDescription: Create and manage AI image and video generations through Quriov's fixed public MCP tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at quriovai.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.quriovai, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your Quriov MCP Access Key.
